Fourier character annihilators count U≤ker X^T and give integer F_k=q^(2n)[k choose2]_q-q^(n+1)[m-2 choose1]_q[k choose1]_q+q^3[m-1 choose2]_q, k=m-rank(X). F_0>0, F_1<0; for k>=3 the first two summands are strictly positive by q^(n-1)[k-1]_q/((q+1)[m-2]_q)>1, while F_2>0 except q=2,n=m, where z=2^(m-2) gives F_2=(8/3)(-z²+6z+1), negative iff m>=5. Thus strict nonzero signs are exhaustive. Counting rank-s matrices N_{m,n}(s) and Σ_X F=q^(mn) yields the exact L1 and L-infinity convolution norms through negative mass, including all prime powers. Independent tests passed 189 (q,m,n) parameter tuples covering 1512 rank sectors, every required orbit/zero-mass sum, and all 512 Walsh Fourier coefficients on the entire binary 3x3 matrix space; binary 5x5 sign transition follows by the exact inequality, not brute-force inference.
